contact.basis: Fixed southwest station front approach[-20,36], retained before new site terrain and unchanged geometry. The first acquisition was at a rejected roadside-marker location; it is archived intact and never fitted or reused. Modern restored greenfield/shore does not establish1963plant ground/foundations.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in historical Big Rock Point photographic station frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; historical station threshold/foundation versus restored greenfield shore grading classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
